title: Context Diet: lazy-load wakeup, lug index + folder archive, context governor, wakeup slim-down
description: WAI eager-loads ~98K tokens of lugs + ~8K tokens of state/skills at wakeup, consuming 50%+ of a 200K context window before work begins. 79% of lugs are completed/archived. This epic restructures WAI from eager-load to selective-hydration.

items.title: Lug folder archive + index
items.description: Split WAI-Lugs.jsonl into typed archive folders + lightweight WAI-LugIndex.jsonl. Only active/ folder loaded at wakeup.

items.title: WAI-State.json slim split
items.description: Extract _migration_state, _closeout_state, _compatibility, _wai_bootstrap into WAI-State-extended.json. Wakeup reads slim file only. Skills read extended on demand.

items.title: Context budget governor
items.description: Traffic-light budget system added to wai.md. GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE are advisory. RED (>80%) auto-prepares closeout — notifies user and begins state preservation. Pre-load check warns before crossing into RED.

items.title: Wakeup skill slim-down
items.description: Trimmed wai.md from 568L to 179L (68% reduction). Removed hub-only steps (fleet health, lug review), duplicate reference sections, verbose mailroom rules. Hub override file already has hub steps.

phase_1.name: Split and index
phase_1.description: Structural changes — archive lugs, slim state, generate index

phase_2.name: Selective hydration
phase_2.description: Wakeup reads only what it needs

principle: Context is a budget, not a landfill.
